Subject: Intro + demo request: Gridline execs (CIO/VP)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro from your partner. We’ve been evaluating inference platforms and would like to set up a 45-minute demo focused on production considerations (latency guarantees, model rollouts, and private deployment options). Our CIO, Priya Mehta, wants to attend and will only be available for a short window late next week. VP of Platforms (Victor Huang) would also like to join if possible.

High level asks:
- 30–45 minute demo targeted to CIO/VP (no deep product deep-dive on API plumbing)
- Pre-brief (15 min) with your AE to align success criteria
- Light SOW/pilot discussion after the demo if alignment looks good

Attached is a short note on our priorities.

Availability: we can do next Wed 6/25 afternoon PT or Thu 6/26 morning ET, but Priya has limited flexibility. Can you propose a few options and confirm who from Redwood will attend?

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Alvarez
Director, Cloud Architecture
Gridline Systems

Tom —

Appreciate the context and the attachment — clear asks. Ben (AE) and Olga (SE) are looped for scheduling and the technical sequencing. Quick thoughts:

- We can do a 45-minute executive-focused demo plus a 15-minute pre-brief earlier the same day.
- For the exec session we recommend: 10 min context + goals, 25 min live demo tailored to your latency/rollout questions, 10 min QA and next steps.
- Ben will lead the SOW/pilot discussion; Olga will run the demo.

Two concrete slots we can hold tentatively for Priya/Victor:
1) Tue 2025-06-24 10:00–10:45 PT (we can pre-brief at 9:30 PT)
2) Thu 2025-06-26 12:00–12:45 ET (pre-brief at 11:30 ET)

If neither fits, share Priya’s available windows and we’ll keep a backup. I attached a brief demo agenda and a FYI pilot-scope doc so your team can decide which points to prioritize.

Next steps: let us know which slot works and who will join from Gridline (names + titles). Once confirmed we’ll send a calendar invite, pre-brief invite, and a short runbook for the demo day.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
